newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia building groups call for rate cut.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia building groups call for rate cut.

text.p: Australian building industry groups renewed calls on Thursday for an interest rate cut, following a fall in building approvals in September.

"The September dwelling approval figures prove that residential building activity is in a fragile state and a cut in official interest rates is overdue," Housing Industry Association national executive director Ron Silverberg said.
Australian building approvals fell 8.6 percent, seasonally-adjusted, to 9,861 in September.

"Apart from isolated pockets, there is no oversupply of housing and it is essential that home buyers be encouraged to re-enter the market to avoid future pent-up demand," Silverberg said in a statement.
Master Builders Australia national director, economics and housing, Wilhelm Harnisch said in a statement the data showed the housing market remained sluggish.

"The September quarter building approvals shows that the housing market is still anaemic and only strengthens the case for an early cut in interest rates by the Reserve Bank," he said. -- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273 2730
